notes: Files ending in browser.json.gz contain same-frame production callback entry/body/exit/next timestamps, per-stage boundaries, raw GPU timer query results and per-frame eye and feet. Controls observe RAF and coordinates without wrapping the app callback.

showInactive in both processes. Trusted W delivered through Chromium CDP. Source kickoff uses ordinary camera buttons, third-person W then first-person W. Before each pair six stationary observations verify spawn; setPose clears velocity. After keyup recorded six samples following a 1.25 s settle.

Metrics grouped by time until the NEXT callback timestamp. Checked coordinates across trials within 0.12 m XZ. Driver render host wall can include GPU synchronization. GPU elapsed can include command-feed gaps. No compositor present trace.

systemSamples.method: Route-window system samples retain the original wall timestamps, numeric machine/device counters and the test-process-tree foreground membership observed by Windows. Only samples inside one of the 12 browser route windows were exported. Window owners, names, paths and process identifiers omitted.
